overview: This Senate resolution formally tells the House of Representatives that the Senate has elected Jennifer A. Hemingway as Sergeant at Arms and Doorkeeper of the Senate. The Sergeant at Arms is the Senate's chief law enforcement and security officer and also manages many of its day-to-day operations. Sending this kind of notice is a standard step at the start of a new Congress. The Senate approved it on January 3, 2025, and sent the message to the House on January 6, 2025.
for: Supporters say the notice keeps the two chambers properly informed about who holds key Senate offices.
against: Critics say the resolution is a routine formality that does not change any law or policy.
